name: 狮城银行 - 工单分流演示

nodes.name: 定时检查（工作流启用后生效）

parameters.query:
SELECT ticket_id, intent, sub_intent, priority, status, created_at
FROM tickets
WHERE status = 'open'
ORDER BY CASE WHEN priority = 'urgent' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, created_at, ticket_id
LIMIT 50

nodes.name: 读取待处理工单
nodes.notes: 使用演示 MySQL 凭据。只读取工单元数据，不读取客户消息。

parameters.jsCode:
const tickets = $input.all().map(({json}) => ({ticket_id: json.ticket_id, intent: json.intent, sub_intent: json.sub_intent ?? null, priority: json.priority, created_at: json.created_at}));
return [{json: {urgent: tickets.filter(t => t.priority === 'urgent'), normal: tickets.filter(t => t.priority !== 'urgent'), count: tickets.length, notification_status: 'not_sent', note: '演示流程：尚未接入通知渠道，也不会更改工单状态。'}}];
